disposition: Accepted prior-theorem applicability with complete elementary cyclic transfer and independent audit.
conclusion: NP-complete for explicit sparse binary and dense characteristic-vector encodings; polynomial-time recognition in either model iff P=NP.
restriction: Hardness already for odd n and nonempty B containing 0 with canonical representatives strictly below n/2; the restricted empty-source branch uses (3,{0}).
dependency: Abboud, Fischer, Safier, Wallheimer, Recognizing Sumsets is NP-Complete, arXiv:2410.18661v2, Theorem 1.2 and page 23; SODA 2025.
scope_limits: same group for target and root
no randomized, approximation, circuit, oracle or average-case conclusion
